By virtue of the provisions of Commonwealth Act Num
bered Thirty-three authorizing the President to receive and
accept donations of money not subject to onerous condition,
made for the purpose of the national defense or support of
the Philippine Army, I, Manuel L. Quezon, President of the
Philippines, do hereby promulgate the following regulations
governing the receipt and acceptance of such donations of
money and the expendituTe thereof, for the information and
guidance of all concerned:

partments, Bureaus, and offices of the ,National Government,
the Chief of Stafi', the Deputy and Assistant Chiefs of Staff,

military commanders, Philippine Army, including provincial,
. city, or municipal treasurers, are authorized to receive and
accept donations of money for the national defense, issuin~
